newsitem.title: KENYA: Bandits said to kill 80 people in northern Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Bandits said to kill 80 people in northern Kenya.

text.p: Bandits from Ethiopia killed 26 people in northern Kenya on Thursday, taking the toll from fighting since Sunday to 80 dead, the Daily Nation newspaper said on Friday.
A police spokesman gave no death toll from clashes between security forces and raiders since Sunday but said 12 policemen and four police reservists went missing in a shootout with the bandits.
The independent Daily Nation said up to 200 raiders from Ethiopia killed 36 people last Sunday in an attack on a camp on the border with Ethiopia and stole cattle, goats and sheep.
Reinforcements were sent to Marsabit district and fighting began on Tuesday when the army spotted the raiders fleeing with livestock. The Nation said bandits ambushed a group of police and troops.
Cattle raids by rival tribesmen armed with automatic rifles and other modern weapons are fairly common in arid northern Kenya, which borders on Ethiopia, Somalia, Sudan and Uganda.
